todos: [P2] FULLTASK-BEHAVIORAL-CLOSURE-01: since 2026-09-24 greenfield JS/TS plans end with a behavioral smoke-test milestone (greenfieldScaffoldResolver.ts, placement 'end', npm test) and a build no longer promotes a milestone that promises behavior (milestoneVerificationPromotion.ts), but scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b has not yet closed 'verified': run 2 planned 11 milestones and verified 9 (m-11 wrongly promoted by the build before the fix; package.json never got a test script), run 3 looped on the uninstallable package tailwindcss-react-components (npm install/npm view repeated, 30 loop advisories, no build ever run) and stopped at 50/50 with 0/9. Next, make the verification_due directive name the missing test script when the active milestone proposes npm test (add vitest + "test": "vitest run"), shorten the uninstallable-dependency loop (it should order dropping the import after the second refused install), and rerun the scenario until closure is 'verified' or the remaining failure mode is tracked.

[P2] GPTOSS-PLAN-JSON-01: on 2026-09-24 ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b npx vitest run --config vitest.live.config.mts scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts stopped before execution: planGenerationAppService failed with 'schema recovery stopped after 2/2 failures ... Invalid plan response: Response is not valid JSON' (110 s). A direct /api/chat probe with gpt-oss:20b, think 'low' and a small JSON schema returned valid JSON (done_reason stop), so structured output itself works; the likely causes are the real planning prompt/schema size, num_predict truncation or the reasoning budget (level-only thinking, ollamaThinkingPolicy.ts). Next, log the raw planning content and done_reason in generateStructuredWithRecovery (structuredGenerationRecovery.ts) when validation fails, reproduce with gpt-oss:20b, fix the cause (budget, think level or schema) model-agnostically, and rerun the full task with both qwen2.5-coder:7b and gpt-oss:20b.

[P3] EXPLICIT-ANY-BACKLOG-01: after LINT-STRICTNESS-01 (2026-09-23) biome.json reports noExplicitAny as a warning and no catch clause uses any (shared/domain/errors/errorMessage.ts), but npx biome lint still lists 239 explicit any (mostly Main HTTP/IPC payloads such as sidecarHttpClient.ts requestJson<any>, sidecarAppService.ts results, and test doubles). Next, type the sidecar/Ollama response envelopes and IPC payloads module by module, then raise noExplicitAny to error for electron/ and shared/ via a biome.json override.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: after I18N-HARDCODED-STRINGS-01 (2026-09-24) the renderer UI, the renderer services (translate() in src/i18n/I18nContext.tsx) and the Sidecar ingestion progress (step_code/step_params) are localized, but text produced in Main still reaches the UI in Italian only: agent timeline emitLog messages and closure summaries (e.g. agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts 'Chiusura applicativa', 'NON VERIFICABILE'/'BLOCCATO', agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...'; the default titles 'Nuova Sessione' (electron/core/domain/sessions/sessionHistoryDomain.ts, used as a custom-title sentinel) and 'Nuova Conversazione' (src/hooks/useChatEngine.ts) are persisted data; the Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors. Next, give Main user-facing events a message code plus params rendered by the renderer (keeping the Italian text the model sees unchanged), replace the title sentinels with an explicit untitled flag, and leave the chunk prefix until a re-index migration exists.
